czech: Když budu mít čas, dokončím to dnes
english: If I have time, I'll finish it today

czech: Když mi pomůžeš, zvládnu to rychleji
english: If you help me, I'll manage it faster
If he's careful, he won't break anything
If she takes an umbrella, she won't get wet
If it gets colder, we'll turn on the heating

czech: Když budete poslouchat pokyny, vyhnete se problémům
english: If you follow the instructions, you'll avoid problems
If they explain it, we'll understand the situation
If you leave now, you'll arrive on time
